style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 50cm Dual Colour Micro LED Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: <strong>Give </strong>your home a cosy or contemporary festive feel with this dual colour micro LED wreath. Featuring realistic faux pine branches, this beautiful wreath measures 50cm in diameter and is lit by 100 micro LED lights scattered across the foliage, which can be set to glow in either a gleaming warm white, a lustrous cool white shade, or a combination of the two.<br><br>Use the cool white setting to style with a neutral decorative scheme – tie gleaming baubles into the foliage and suspend the wreath over a mirror. Use the warm white or combination setting to pair with ivory TruGlow® pillar candles on a mantlepiece and add a velvet bow for a luxurious touch.<br><br>All wreaths and garlands will require styling on arrival, lay flat, and tease the foliage for a styled and finished look. Shaping your foliage may result in some variance from the listed dimensions.<br><br>To illuminate, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the attached battery box. Use the switch on the box to select your preferred colourway and to set the handy 6-hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Size: ONE Height 10cm Width 10cm Depth 10cm
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Give your home a cosy or contemporary festive feel with this dual colour micro LED wreath. Featuring realistic faux pine branches, this beautiful wreath measures 50cm in diameter and is lit by 100 micro LED lights scattered across the foliage, which can be set to glow in either a golden warm white, an icy silver shade, or a combination of the two. Use the cool white setting to style with a neutral decorative scheme – tie silver baubles into the foliage and suspend the wreath over a mirror. Use the warm white or combination setting to pair with ivory TruGlow® pillar candles on a mantlepiece and add a velvet bow for a luxurious touch. All wreaths and garlands will require styling on arrival, lay flat, and tease the foliage for a styled and finished look. Shaping your foliage may result in some variance from the listed dimensions. To illuminate, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the attached battery box. Use the switch on the box to select your preferred colourway and to set the handy 6-hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Size: ONE Height 10cm Width 10cm Depth 10cm 44% Iron, 41% Polyurethane, 9% PVC, 4% Polypropylene, 2% Copper.
